summary.text: Larry Strickland is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 28 since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and previously served on the Johnston County Schools Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Larry Strickland served on the Johnston County Schools Board of Education as an at-large member from 1999 to 2016.
He assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2017, succeeding James Langdon Jr.
In the 2023-2024 legislative session, Strickland chaired the Appropriations Committee and was vice chair of the Appropriations on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources Committee.
He also sat on the Agriculture, Commerce, Education - K-12, and Energy and Public Utilities committees that session.
